unit_label: Section 4: Rationalbasis der Körper K_{n rho}
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice; English control slice reserved only as a sanity witness.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 5 and later content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading: rational basis of fields K_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Rationalbasis continues the established rational-basis lane: раціональна база / рациональная база / racionalna baza.

segment_summaries.content: Section 4 announces systematic use of the transfer principle for basis questions and starts with fields while giving general definitions.
segment_summaries.choices: Übertragungsprinzip remains Ukrainian `принцип перенесення`, Russian `принцип переноса`, Interslavic `princip prěnosa`.

segment_summaries.content: Definition III: a finite number of functions is a rational basis if every system function is a rational combination with coefficients in Omega.
segment_summaries.choices: Verbindung is rendered as combination in all three lanes; finite-number language is kept visible.

segment_summaries.content: A rational basis must contain rho algebraically independent functions; ranks agree.
segment_summaries.choices: Algebraically independent and algebraic rank follow the Paper 06 Section 1 terminology.

segment_summaries.content: Noether first shows that the existence proof for rational bases admits the transfer principle.
segment_summaries.choices: The proof-permits-transfer phrase is kept as proof structure, not paraphrased away.

segment_summaries.content: Definition III is restated as infinitely many relations f = gamma(g_1,...,g_k).
segment_summaries.choices: Gamma is described as changing with f; this dependence is explicit in all languages.

segment_summaries.content: A rational basis in the mapping system implies the corresponding relations in the original system by Theorem I.
segment_summaries.choices: Abbildungssystem continues as system of mapping / `odobražajuči sistem`.

segment_summaries.content: Transfer principle for rational bases stated and footnoted as applying to each basis question treated here.
segment_summaries.choices: The italic transfer statement is preserved as a source-visible mini-theorem.

segment_summaries.content: To prove rational bases for all fields, it is enough to treat K*_{rho rho}; Steinitz's argument is generalized.
segment_summaries.choices: Steinitz citation data remain Latin in the Interslavic Cyrillic reader; prose name normalized to `Штайницом`.

segment_summaries.content: Choose rho algebraically independent functions in K*; elimination gives rho relations, showing x_i are algebraic over Omega(g_i*). Intermediate-field reasoning gives finite generation by adjoining finitely many elements or one suitable function.
segment_summaries.choices: The German algebraischer Körper über is modernized as finite algebraic extension over the base field in Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic.

segment_summaries.content: Transition back via the transfer principle.
Theorem II: every field K_{n rho} has a rational basis of algebraic rank rho; it can be chosen with at most rho+1 functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Satz is theorem; at-most rho+1 bound preserved exactly.

segment_summaries.content: Any rho algebraically independent functions h_i can be extended to a rational basis; mutual rational expressions relate h_i and g_j.
segment_summaries.choices: Definitionseigenschaft rendered as defining property / opreděljajuče svojstvo.

segment_summaries.content: Any further rational basis is obtained from a given one by birational transformation.
segment_summaries.choices: Birationale Transformation rendered directly as birational transformation.

segment_summaries.content: Any rho algebraically independent functions h_i make K_{n rho} a finite algebraic extension of Omega(h_i).
segment_summaries.choices: The closing consequence is modernized as finite algebraic extension while preserving Noether's field-language structure.

Review Interslavic `konečno algebraično razširenje` as the long-term rendering of finite algebraic extension.
Review `Definicija III` and `Teorema II` morphology in both Latin and Cyrillic Interslavic with an authority speaker.
